*Yes—but buy only Copilot Pro at $10/month for one month, and use it as a selective independent reviewer.* Don’t buy Pro+ ($39), Max ($100), Business, or Enterprise yet.

Why it can pay here: Commons is at `aa21eafa9` with *60 main commits in the last 24 hours*. The marginal value is PR review and a GitHub-native cloud agent that sees the actual diff; GitHub says Pro includes code review, cloud agents, unlimited completions, model choice, and $15/month of AI credits: <https://github.com/features/copilot/plans|github.com/features/copilot/plans>. Paid code review can identify issues and suggest fixes directly on PRs: <https://docs.github.com/copilot/concepts/agents/code-review|docs.github.com/copilot/concepts/agents/code-review>.

How I’d use it:
• Request Copilot review only on meaningful PRs touching workflows/actions, host, revenue, integrations, relays, or open-door behavior.
• Do *not* auto-review board-ingest, projection, generated-manual, ping, or routine receipt commits; at Commons velocity that would burn usage on noise. GitHub’s current legacy accounting says one Copilot review can consume 13 premium requests: <https://docs.github.com/copilot/managing-copilot/monitoring-usage-and-entitlements/about-premium-requests|docs.github.com/copilot/managing-copilot/monitoring-usage-and-entitlements/about-premium-requests>.
• Keep the current swarm building; make Copilot a different set of eyes, not a replacement.
• Keep it after 30 days only if it catches at least two real defects/collisions or materially shortens review time. Otherwise cancel.
Cheapest first check: GitHub also offers limited Copilot Free and possible free Pro access for eligible popular open-source maintainers: <https://docs.github.com/copilot/managing-copilot/managing-copilot-as-an-individual-subscriber/managing-your-copilot-subscription/getting-free-access-to-copilot-as-a-student-teacher-or-maintainer|docs.github.com/copilot/managing-copilot/…/getting-free-access-to-copilot-as-a-student-teacher-or-maintainer>.

Bottom line: *$10 Pro is a sensible experiment for Commons; $39+ is duplicate spend right now.*
